note: TeaCache becomes functional after wiring teacache_signal in cosmos3video.forward (the per-step time_embed stash). Adaptive cache decides per-step based on rescaled rel-L1 of the timestep-modulated input; with the LTX-2.3 prior (threshold=0.04, start_step=6, max_hits=1) it lands at 1.30x, short of step_cache 12-28/0.5 (1.733x) on the same baseline. Step_cache wins as the STEP_OUTPUT-seam owner; teacache is kept on the bench for future per-tier tuning.
